care.summary: Heat-loving nightshade vegetable producing glossy purple fruit; needs long warm seasons.
care.water: Deep, consistent watering; avoid wild wet–dry swings
care.soil: Fertile, well-drained soil amended with compost
care.toxicity: Leaves toxic if chewed; fruit edible when cooked
tips: Use black mulch to warm soil
care.climate_notes: Outdoor summer crop in subtropical climates; greenhouse help in cooler temperate zones.
